raw_snippet: In connection with the Series C Financing, NVIDIA entered into Pre-Series C SAFEs for a principal amount of $300.0 million, which converted into 16,346,160 Series C preferred shares. NVIDIA subscribed for a further 23,410,920 Series C preferred shares for $477.4 million
note: Nvidia -> Nscale equity in the Series C (SAFE plus direct subscription). Nscale Form S-1 related-party section; no earlier party statement of Nvidia's amount found. Keyed apart from the same day's pre-IPO sale, which is a separate deal.
